# EDAD Advertising

> EDAD Advertising is an Amazon growth agency specializing in listing optimization and PPC advertising (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display) for brands selling on Amazon. Works with brands worldwide.

## Services
- [Listing Optimization](https://edadadvertising.com/#listing-optimization): SEO-rich titles, bullet points and descriptions, so more shoppers find your product and buy it.
- [PPC Management](https://edadadvertising.com/#ppc-management): Sponsored Products, Brands and Display campaigns built to grow sales while keeping TACoS under control.
- [Product Launch](https://edadadvertising.com/#product-launch): A full-funnel launch plan that builds awareness, rank and sales from day one.
- [Full Amazon Management](https://edadadvertising.com/#full-management): Listings and advertising run together by one team, with one strategy and one point of contact.
